notes.title: Version 1.0.1
notes.content:
Partitas now has Steam Achievements, so those who finish the game will have more challenges.

In addition, in this version some small details have been improved:
[list]
[*] Menu play button is programmed to prevent players from not seeing cutscenes when they return from the menu;
[*] Pepe is more present in the game and closer to the players (no spoilers here ;D).
[/list]

Hope you like it!

- Lotz
